text: In 1497, Ovid's works, including Ars Amatoria, were burned in the Piazza della Signoria, Florence, at the instigation of Savonarola, an Italian Dominican priest who crusaded against "immoral art". In 1564, Ars Amatoria was added to the Catholic Index for "treating of lascivious or obscene objects".
